name: brain_capture
description: Capture a thought, note, idea, todo, reminder, or any free-form information to the user's brain inbox for later classification. Use whenever the user asks you to remember, add, save, note, or jot something down. The text should be in the user's own words with enough detail that it's useful later.

text.description: The content to capture, phrased naturally. Include who/what/when/why details if the user mentioned them.
